newsitem.title: UK: W.H. Smith plans share buy-back.
newsitem.headline: W.H. Smith plans share buy-back.

text.p: British retailer W.H.Smith group Plc said on Friday it would seek authority from shareholders to buy back up to 28.5 million of its ordinary shares -- around 10 percent of its issued capital.

The company said it would buy shares at prices not exceeding 105 percent of the average of the middle market quotation taken from the Official List for the five business days before any purchase. The minimum price would be 50 pence per share.
W H Smith said shareholders would be asked to approve the buyback plan at an extraordinary general meeting on August 19 before its preliminary results on August 27.
It said the earliest date it could make share repurchases would be after the results statement.
